description: This file defines the LanguageManager class which manages language files, caching, loading, and refreshing language strings for modules in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for creating, loading, caching, clearing cache, and handling module-specific language files.

classes.name: LanguageManager
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing language files, caching, and loading language strings for modules.

methods.name: createLanguageFile
methods.description: Creates or refreshes the language file cache for a module.

methods.name: loadTemplateLanguage
methods.description: Loads language templates for a module, merging multiple templates.

methods.name: addTemplate
methods.description: Adds a language template for a module from specified paths.

methods.name: saveCache
methods.description: Saves loaded language strings to cache files and cache system.

methods.name: clearLanguageCache
methods.description: Clears cached language files for modules and languages.

methods.name: _clearCache
methods.description: Internal method to clear specific cache files for a module and language.

methods.name: refreshLanguage
methods.description: Refreshes language strings for a module by searching language files and caching the result.

methods.name: loadModuleLanguage
methods.description: Loads a module's language strings from cache or from files if cache is missing or needs refresh.

methods.name: getLanguageCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string for a module and language.

methods.name: removeJSLanguageFiles
methods.description: Removes cached JavaScript language files and updates cache version.
